<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> can be gathered from [[Bee hive|bee hives]]. It can be used directly to restore {{Health||3}} and {{Energy||25}}, used in recipes for food and drinks, and decomposed in the alchemy laboratory into reagents.

==Alchemy==
Honey can be decomposed into [[acceleration solution|solution]] and [[acceleration powder|powder]] with the [[hand mixer]] and [[alchemy mill]], respectively. Having unlocked [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
